items.html: And there is another reason, as mentioned above, for how it could be that the cause of the breaking of the vessels of ZON was the separation between them, and now, in the secret of the ibbur, when they were included three within three in the secret of lines, they became fully unified, and through this they were corrected — see this matter there. And therefore, even though ZA did not need to be included three within three, it was so because of the strong bond and firm unity within them, for this is the main beginning of his correction. However, Atik and Arich, who are long and tall in stature, and part of them remained unclothed, needed to gather part of what was revealed above, to make garments for themselves through the correction of Zeir and his Nukva, as written.
